svg.title: Finger width
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Measure my hand, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: finger width at 26 mm. Marked in red: 1, the pocket: the plug recess on the centerline. 2, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. 3, the finger holes: the two large holes in the lower half. 4, the wall notch and the body edge.
